summary: Retiring a work scope no longer fails with 'No such device (os error 19)' when systemd removes the emptied scope's cgroup while the retirement is still waiting on its cgroup.events. A held descriptor of a removed cgroup now counts as empty, because the kernel removes a cgroup only when it holds no processes; any other read error still fails the retirement.

replay.detail: No claim, replay or projection change.

rules.detail: No rule, permission or trust change. The ending proof's checks are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No wire, CLI or client change.

downtime.detail: Takes effect when the daemon restarts on the new build.

recovery.detail: Revert the commit; retirements can then fail again when they lose the race.
